question: Do the fixed TIGIT-PRDM1, CCR2 and IGFBP4 candidates show reciprocal directions across DuPage loss and Peeters gain contexts, and how stable are the gain-context descriptive contrasts to single-library omission?
decision: Describe candidate-specific baseline and activated gain-context profiles to refine protein/context qualification without selecting a winner or asserting mediation.
strongest_rival: Y641F biochemistry, genetic controls, culture/IL-2 exposure, source selection and survivor composition differ from knockout observed states; selected rlog release and unknown source units restrict interpretation.
discriminator: Separate genotype differences before and after in-vitro activation and retain omission sensitivity, missing genes and discordant signs; do not pool magnitudes or infer causal effects.
exposure_record: All DuPage outcomes and primary literature were exposed, including published Peeters TIGIT and CD25 directions. GEO family metadata, matrix header and selection rule inspected; candidate rlog values not inspected before this freeze. Overall exposed exploration.
biological_unit: Source Treg preparation; GEO declares three libraries per group but individual animals, pooling and cross-state pairing are unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve GSE262130 libraries; no verified animal mapping. DuPage table is preserved discovery evidence; Peeters has different samples/design but independence is not asserted. Reanalysis is not independent validation.
population_and_selection: CD62L-positive sorted murine Tregs with Ezh2 Y641F or WT, immediately sorted or cultured four days with CD3/CD28 and IL-2. Published matrix is a union selected by authors adjusted p < 0.05 across six comparisons.
contrast: Mean rlog Y641F-WT at freshly sorted N and day4 D4; activation differences within genotype and difference of gain contrasts. Qualitative sign comparison to DuPage KO-HET high/low only.
endpoint: Fixed-gene rlog sample values, descriptive contrasts, 13-configuration omission ranges and source-limited direction relations.
methods: CANDIDATE_ANALYSIS_PLAN_V1.md. Fixed candidates Tigit,Prdm1,Ccr2,Igfbp4; anchors Areg,Il2ra,Igf1r. Exact unique symbols only. Primary plus 12 leave-one-library configurations; no new inferential tests, fitting, pseudocounts or threshold changes. Render source-bound profiles and distinct-unit direction panels.
missingness_and_exclusions: No sample exclusion. Missing/ambiguous symbols retained as unavailable; not null expression. No imputation or substitute genes. Selected release restricts assessability.
multiplicity: Seven fixed symbols, four candidates plus three contextual anchors. No new p-values, FDR or selection based on observed gain-context outcomes.
precision_basis: No independent animal variance or meaningful margin established. Omission ranges are not confidence intervals.
interpretation_limit: Descriptive exposed cross-context reanalysis of an outcome-selected transformed matrix. Neither independent validation nor direct target, protein, secretion, homing, repair, necessity or causal function evidence.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/header mismatch, malformed records, duplicate sample labels or nonfinite eligible values. Missing/ambiguous genes get explicit unavailable records. Do not replace candidates or overwrite output directories.
amendment_reason: New candidate-focused cross-context follow-up; existing DuPage contracts and outputs remain unchanged.
